verification_model.structural_status: Checks exact stages, required nonempty sections, order, dependency ordering, and workspace-contained local Markdown links. Does not infer meaning.
verification_model.traceability_status: PASS only when a verifier-owned graph is supplied, tied to the exact roadmap SHA-256, with hashed source-section units and complete stage-exit links among objectives, dependencies, deliverables, acceptance criteria, validation methods, evidence, and exit conditions. Missing graph is REVIEW_REQUIRED; supplied stale, invented, or inconsistent graph is FAIL.
verification_model.semantic_status: REVIEW_REQUIRED unless a separate trusted-key semantic_review verifies the exact current roadmap hash and every configured criterion observation.
verification_model.owner_acceptance: PENDING unless a distinct trusted-key owner_acceptance review verifies the exact current roadmap hash and owner criterion observation.
verification_model.overall_status: Required failures yield FAIL; required unreviewed semantic/owner criteria yield REVIEW_REQUIRED; PASS requires all mandatory machine checks plus both authorized, current, signed review criteria.
verification_model.semantic_limit: The verifier expressly does not claim to understand natural-language meaning. Reviewer signatures attest signed bytes/key identity, not thoughtful assessment.

review_trust.result: Canonical roadmap semantic acceptance is REVIEW_REQUIRED and owner acceptance remains PENDING. A later addition of trust identities requires a source-pinned verifier-policy change, not a claim/review-supplied key.
